subject.title: [Bug]: z.ai endpoint auto-detection probe sends no User-Agent → z.ai 429s it, detectZaiEndpoint returns null, Coding Plan onboarding fails

question: Should maintainers require a live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke before landing one of the linked User-Agent fixes, or accept source/unit proof plus the reporter's supplied live output?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the decisive external-service behavior needs credentials that are not available in this review environment.

options.title: Land after focused PR proof
options.body: Review the strongest linked PR and land it once header regression tests pass, using reporter live output as the external proof until credentials are available.

options.title: Require maintainer live smoke
options.body: Pause the linked PRs until a maintainer can run a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan detection smoke against the real service.

options.title: Close duplicate PRs first
options.body: Pick a canonical PR, close the other open duplicates, and then complete proof on the chosen branch.

recommendation.title: Land after focused PR proof
recommendation.body: Review the strongest linked PR and land it once header regression tests pass, using reporter live output as the external proof until credentials are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and his history is strongest on the Z.AI onboarding/detection path.
